text:
alex.d: Heads up — planning a base-image rebuild next week to minimize ephemeral layers, add cosign attestation, and tighten registry RBAC. Need coordination across infra, runtime, and oncall.
maya.s: +1. Do we have a list of packages causing most of the image bloat? Also need KMS key ownership for cosign signing.
tolga: I can run a layer analysis. Quick wins: remove build-time deps, squash some intermediate layers, enable multi-stage builds. Will post a diff.
carla: Registry RBAC: we'll need to create an `image-signers` role with push + attestation permissions and restrict it to a service account. Who owns the SA? @alex.d?
alex.d: Yes, infra can own the SA. Plan: infra creates SA, grant Artifact Registry write + Pub/Sub publish (for scan events). Security will hold the cosign KMS key policy.
maya.s: For KMS, prefer Cloud KMS with key access limited to `image-signers` only. Also want rotation policy and CMEK audit entries enabled. @carla can you confirm audit log sinks keep admin activity for 13 months?
carla: Org audit logs already retained 13 months, but Artifact Registry data-access needs to be enabled at project level. I'll open a ticket and tag ops-oncall for any retention changes.
security-bot: SNYK SCAN REPORT for base-image:v2026-03-20

HIGH: 1 (glibc CVE-2025-xxxx)
MEDIUM: 2 (libssl, curl)
LOW: 4 (pkg-config, tzdata)
Recommendations: patch glibc or pin to minimal distro, rebuild with patched base.

eva: Glibc patch might force a glibc rebuild across images. Can we instead move to distroless or alpine if compatibility allows?
maya.s: Distroless reduces attack surface but breaks quickly for debugging. I'd rather keep ubuntu:22.04 minimal and strip locales + docs.
tolga: I ran `dive` locally. Biggest offenders: python3-dev, build-essential, apt caches. I put up a branch with a multi-stage Dockerfile and `--no-install-recommends`.
alex.d: Thanks. Two operational Qs: 1) cosign signing flow + KMS command; 2) rollout window.
maya.s: Example cosign sign using GCP KMS:
```
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cosign \
  gcr.io/redwood-prod/base-image@sha256:abcdef123456
```
Make sure `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner` is on the SA.
carla: I'll prepare a PR that creates the SA and binds `roles/artifactregistry.writer` + `roles/cloudkms.signer` to it. Also add a condition to limit to `serviceAccount:infra-signers@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
ops-oncall: Suggest weekend low-traffic window: Sat 03:00–06:00 UTC. We should include a fallback: if a rollout fails, automatic revert to previous manifest and revoke new attestation.
alex.d: Agree on revert guard. Also we need audit hooks: when an image is signed, create an audit entry with who triggered the sign + pipeline run id. That ties into compliance.
maya.s: We already have an audit pipeline for deploys. Add an entry for `cosign:sign` events via Cloud Audit Logs or a Pub/Sub push from the signing pipeline.
tolga: Runtime note: KV cache invalidation needed when base-image changes. Will add a cache-bust flag in the rollout so clients warm gradually.
eva: For vuln triage: I'll queue the glibc fix in the next patch train and create an exception ticket for CVE until patch is deployed. Link: https://go/internal/CVE-2025-xxxx
carla: PR created: #4823 creates infra-signers SA + IAM bindings + logging sink enable. Tagging @alex.d for approval.
alex.d: Reviewing now. If all good, let's target Sat 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC deploy. Please add rollback playbook to the PR.
ops-oncall: I'll be on call that Saturday. Please ping `#eng-oncall` 30m before the window. We'll run a quick smoke: pull signed image, run container, healthcheck.
maya.s: One last ask: enable artifact attestation verification in the runtime admission controller. If unsigned images are used, deny unless exempted by a policy.
tolga: I'll add admission controller checks to block unsigned images in prod cluster and allow a `ci-exempt` annotation for build jobs.
alex.d: Great. Summarize next steps: (1) carla finishes SA+IAM PR, (2) tolga posts image diff + cache strategy, (3) maya finalizes KMS policy + audit hooks, (4) ops runs deploy on 2026-03-28 with rollback plan. Thanks everyone :thumbsup
